cdc_auto_drop_slot.description: Whether PostHog drops the replication slot automatically when lag is critical, to protect the source database disk. Only applies in 'posthog' management mode. Defaults to true.

cdc_lag_critical_threshold_mb.description: Replication lag in MB above which the lag is critical. Must be higher than the warning threshold.

cdc_lag_warning_threshold_mb.description: Replication lag in MB above which a warning shows. Must be lower than the critical threshold.

cdc_management_mode.description:
Who owns the replication slot and publication. 'posthog' (default) lets PostHog create and drop them, which needs a database user that can manage replication. 'self_managed' expects the customer to have created the publication already; PostHog only creates the slot.

* `posthog` - PostHog
* `self_managed` - Self managed

cdc_publication_name.description: Name of the publication to read changes from. Defaults to a name derived from the source id, or 'posthog_pub' in self_managed mode.

cdc_slot_name.description: Name of the replication slot to use. Defaults to a name derived from the source id.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this external data source.
